theorem isCommitted_mono [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l1 l2 : List EntryM) : l1 <+: l2 → ⊢
    isCommitted γ l2 -∗ isCommitted γ l1

theorem TrackedOk.of_sub {γ : RaftNames} {P : GSet w64} {id : w64} (hP : P ⊆ γ.reCfg) (hid : id ∈
    γ.reCfg) : TrackedOk γ (CfgM.simple γ.reCfg (P \ γ.reCfg)) id

theorem leadFull_agree [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (t : w64) (G1 G2 : List EntryM) (j : w64) :
    (plogTermAt base0 G1 j).isSome = true → (plogTermAt base0 G2 j).isSome = true → ⊢ leadFull γ t
    G1 -∗ leadFull γ t G2 -∗ ⌜plogTermAt base0 G1 j = plogTermAt base0 G2 j⌝

theorem propData_stampTk [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (e : EntryM) (t i : w64) : ⊢ propData γ e -∗
    entTk γ e ==∗ entData γ { Term' := t, Index' := i, Type' := e.Type', Data' := e.Data' }

structure RaftNames : Type 1 where
  reCfg : GSet w64
  reVotes : GMap w64 GName
  reTerms : GMap w64 GName
  reAcks : GMap w64 GName
  reCamp : GMap w64 GName
  reVlogs : GMap w64 GName
  reWins : GMap w64 GName
  reEvs : GMap w64 GName
  reCommit : GName
  reProps : GName
  reRLog : GName
  reFresh : GName
  reLcm : GMap w64 GName
  reRdq : GMap w64 GName
  reReads : GName
  reRdFresh : GName
  reRdCred : GName
  reTbl : GName
  reDyn : Option ((e : GooseExts) → DynCfg)
  reCCOk : Prop
  reBootRaw : List BootEntry
  reCfg_ne : self.reCfg ≠ ∅
  reTracked : Option (GSet w64)
  reTracked_ok : self.reCfg ⊆ T ∧ self.reDyn = none
  reNoSnap : Bool
  reNoSnap_ok : self.reBootRaw ≠ []
  reNoXfer : Bool
  reNoXfer_ok : self.reBootRaw ≠ []
  reSnapOkRaw : Prop
  reSnapLoc : Option GName
  reNs : Namespace
  reCertNs : Namespace
  reSnapReg : Option GName
  reDec : Option GName

theorem witsB_agree [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F F' : List EntryM) (lim : Nat) (B : Int) :
    List.take lim F' = List.take lim F → ⊢ witsB γ F lim B -∗ witsB γ F' lim B

theorem isEntryR_term_pos [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (e : EntryM) (pt : w64) : ⊢ isEntryR γ e pt
    -∗ ⌜γ.reBoot ≠ [] → 1 ≤ uint.Z e.Term'⌝

def deposited (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ p, d ↪[γ.reProps]□ p)

theorem RaftNames.dyn_eq_none {γ : RaftNames} : γ.dyn = none ↔ γ.reDyn = none

def CfgM_countable : Pos.Countable CfgM :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective
    (fun c => Pos.Countable.encode (c.incoming, c.outgoing, c.learners, c.learnersNext, c.autoLeave))
    CfgM_countable._proof_1

theorem isLeader_unique [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id1 id2 term : w64) : ⊢ isLeader γ id1 term
    -∗ isLeader γ id2 term -∗ ⌜id1 = id2⌝

theorem commitJ_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F : List EntryM) (c tm : w64) : Timeless
    (commitJ γ F c tm)

theorem decLb_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (M : DecMap) : Persistent (decLb γ M)

def raftSnapCert [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (k : SnapTrip) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜∀ (x : w64), k.cl.Has x → SnapListsOk k⌝ ∗
      ⌜γ.reDyn = none →
            ∀ (x : w64),
              k.cl.Has x →
                listToSet k.cl.voters = γ.reCfg ∧
                  k.cl.outgoing = [] ∧ ∀ (T : GSet w64), γ.reTracked = some T → k.cfgM.voters ∪ k.cfgM.learners ⊆ T⌝ ∗
        (□
            ∀ x,
              ⌜k.cl.Has x⌝ -∗
                ∀ D,
                  ⌜γ.dyn = some D⌝ -∗
                    ∀ fp, logRecs γ base0 fp -∗ ⌜FullOk k.sid fp⌝ -∗ ∃ M, decLb γ M ∗ ⌜D.fold M fp = some k.cfgM⌝) ∗
          snapAtOk γ k)

structure BootEntry : Type where
  term : w64
  index : w64
  type : w32
  data : List w8

theorem ackAgree_term [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (t i ldr' :
    w64) (bL : entryID) (l' : List EntryM) (j : w64) : PlogWfR b es → uint.Z b.index' ≤ uint.Z j →
    uint.Z bL.index' ≤ uint.Z j → uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z i → (plogTermAt bL l' j).isSome = true → ⊢
    logRecs γ b es -∗ ackAgree γ b es t i -∗ leadPrefix γ ldr' t bL l' -∗ ⌜plogTermAt b es j =
    plogTermAt bL l' j⌝

def Filler (ty : w32) (d : List w8) : Prop :=
  d = [] ∧ ty = W32 0

theorem logRecs_boot_take [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F : List EntryM) : PlogWf base0 F → ⊢
    logRecs γ base0 F -∗ ⌜∀ (n : Nat), n ≤ γ.reBoot.length → n ≤ F.length → List.take n F =
    List.take n γ.reBoot⌝

theorem isCampK_boot [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (c T : w64) (F : List EntryM) (k : w64) : ⊢
    isCampK γ c T F k -∗ ⌜γ.reBoot <+: F ∧ (γ.reBoot ≠ [] → 2 ≤ uint.Z T)⌝

def ackAgree [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (t i : w64) : IProp GF
    :=
  iprop(⌜uint.Z i ≤ plogLastIndexZ b es⌝ ∗
      ∃ ldr bL l,
        leadPrefix γ ldr t bL l ∗
          ⌜(plogTermAt bL l i).isSome = true ∧ plogTermAt bL l i = plogTermAt b es i⌝ ∗ ∃ fp, lpfull γ ldr t bL l fp)

theorem ownCommitted_alloc_at [ReceiptGS GF] (l : List EntryM) : ⊢ |==> ∃ γc, monoListAuthOwn γc 1 l
    ∗ monoListLbOwn γc l

def witsB [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F : List EntryM) (lim : Nat) (B : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ k x x, ∃ t' n' G' a' c' q' x, cqAt γ t' n' G' a' c' q')

theorem decLb_mono [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (M M' : DecMap) (h : M' ⊆ M) : decLb γ M ⊢ decLb γ
    M'

theorem leadFull_wf [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (t : w64) (G : List EntryM) : ⊢ leadFull γ t G -∗
    ⌜PlogWf base0 G ∧ ∀ (j x : w64), plogTermAt base0 G j = some x → uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z t⌝ ∗ logRecs
    γ base0 G

def entTk (γ : RaftNames) (e : EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  if Filler e.Type' e.Data' then iprop(emp) else propTk γ (entKey e.Type' e.Data')

def decLb (γ : RaftNames) (M : DecMap) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜γ.reDec = none → M = ∅⌝ ∗ □ ∀ g, ⌜γ.reDec = some g⌝ -∗ ∀ k v, ⌜M !! k = some v⌝ -∗ k ↪[g]□ v)

theorem snapRegOk_timeless (γ : RaftNames) (i : w64) (d : List w8) : Timeless (snapRegOk γ i d)

theorem entDataIs_agree [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (e : EntryM) (o1 o2 : Option (List w8)) : ⊢
    entDataIs γ e o1 -∗ entDataIs γ e o2 -∗ ⌜o1 = o2⌝

def BootRec (L : List EntryM) (e : EntryM) (pt : w64) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ uint.Z e.Index' ∧
    L[(uint.Z e.Index' - 1).toNat]? = some e ∧ e.Term' = W64 1 ∧ pt = if uint.Z e.Index' = 1 then W64 0 else W64 1

def entryID_countable : Pos.Countable entryID :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun b => Pos.Countable.encode (b.term', b.index')) ⋯

theorem msgTks_nonprop [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) (h : m.ty ≠ MsgType.propose) :
    msgTks γ m = iprop(emp)

theorem entData_timeless (γ : RaftNames) (e : EntryM) : Timeless (entData γ e)

theorem logRecs_agree [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (b1 : entryID) (es1 : List EntryM) (b2 :
    entryID) (es2 : List EntryM) : ⊢ logRecs γ b1 es1 -∗ logRecs γ b2 es2 -∗ ⌜RecsAgree b1 es1 b2
    es2⌝

def propTk (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ p k γt, d ↪[γ.reProps]□ p ∗ k ↪[p.snd]□ γt ∗ dghostVar γt (DFrac.own 1) none)

def logRecs [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  [∗list] k ↦ e ∈ es,
    if uint.Z b.index' + ↑k + 1 < 2 ^ 64 then iprop(∃ pt, ⌜plogTermAt b es (pidx b k) = some pt⌝ ∗ isEntryR γ e pt)
    else iprop(True)

def BootEntry.toEntry (b : BootEntry) : EntryM :=
  { Term' := b.term, Index' := b.index, Type' := b.type, Data' := b.data }

theorem propDataIs_agree [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (e : EntryM) (o1 o2 : Option (List w8)) : ⊢
    propDataIs γ e o1 -∗ propDataIs γ e o2 -∗ ⌜o1 = o2⌝

theorem isCommitted_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) : Persistent (isCommitted γ l)

theorem raftSnapCertD_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (k : SnapTrip) : Timeless
    (raftSnapCertD γ k)

theorem cqAt_parts [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (t n : w64) (G : List EntryM) (a : w64) (c : CfgM)
    (q : GSet w64) : ⊢ cqAt γ t n G a c q -∗ ∃ M, ⌜plogTermAt base0 G n = some t ∧ uint.Z a ≤ uint.Z
    n ∧ CfgAt γ M (List.take (uint.Z a).toNat G) c ∧ JQuorum c q⌝ ∗ decLb γ M ∗ leadFull γ t G ∗
    isCommitted γ (List.take (uint.Z a).toNat G) ∗ ([∗map] v ↦ _u ∈ toMap q, iprop(∃ i', ⌜uint.Z n ≤
    uint.Z i'⌝ ∗ isAcked γ v t i')) ∗ dynOn γ (cqDyn γ t G a)

theorem propsOf_subperm (o' o : List Msg) (h : o'.Subperm o) : (propsOf o').Subperm (propsOf o)

theorem isWin_timeless (γ : RaftNames) (id term : w64) (q : GSet w64) : Timeless (isWin γ id term q)

theorem CfgAt.overlap {γ : RaftNames} {M1 M2 : DecMap} {P1 P2 : List EntryM} {c1 c2 : CfgM} (Hst :
    γ.reDyn = none) (H1 : CfgAt γ M1 P1 c1) (H2 : CfgAt γ M2 P2 c2) : QOverlap c1 c2

theorem RaftNames.noSnap_boot {γ : RaftNames} (h : γ.reNoSnap = true) : γ.reBoot ≠ []

theorem ackIn_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (t i : w64) : Persistent (ackIn γ t i)

theorem isCommitted_prefix [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l l' : List EntryM) : ⊢ isCommitted γ l
    -∗ ownCommitted γ l' -∗ ⌜l <+: l'⌝

theorem isCamp_boot [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (c T : w64) (F : List EntryM) : ⊢ isCamp γ c T F
    -∗ ⌜γ.reBoot <+: F ∧ (γ.reBoot ≠ [] → 2 ≤ uint.Z T)⌝

theorem BootRec_ne (L : List EntryM) (e : EntryM) (pt : w64) : BootRec L e pt → L ≠ []

theorem commitIn_move [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F F' : List EntryM) (c tm tm' : w64) : uint.Z
    tm ≤ uint.Z tm' → PlogWf base0 F → PlogWf base0 F' → (plogTermAt base0 F c).isSome = true →
    plogTermAt base0 F' c = plogTermAt base0 F c → ⊢ logRecs γ base0 F -∗ logRecs γ base0 F' -∗
    commitIn γ F c tm -∗ commitIn γ F' c tm'

theorem isEntryR_pt [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (e : EntryM) (pt : w64) : ⊢ isEntryR γ e pt -∗
    ⌜uint.Z pt ≤ uint.Z e.Term'⌝

theorem leadPrefix_agree [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (L1 L2 t : w64) (b : entryID) (l1 l2 : List
    EntryM) (j : w64) : (plogTermAt b l1 j).isSome = true → (plogTermAt b l2 j).isSome = true → ⊢
    leadPrefix γ L1 t b l1 -∗ leadPrefix γ L2 t b l2 -∗ ⌜plogTermAt b l1 j = plogTermAt b l2 j⌝

theorem raftSnapCert_decs [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (k : SnapTrip) (fp : List EntryM) (x : w64)
    (hx : k.cl.Has x) (hf : FullOk k.sid fp) : ⊢ raftSnapCert γ k -∗ logRecs γ base0 fp -∗ ∃ M,
    decLb γ M ∗ ⌜∀ (D : DynCfg), γ.dyn = some D → D.fold M fp = some k.cfgM⌝

theorem propDataIs_stamp [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (e : EntryM) (t i : w64) (o : Option (List
    w8)) : propDataIs γ { Term' := t, Index' := i, Type' := e.Type', Data' := e.Data' } o =
    propDataIs γ e o

theorem isVote_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (v term cand : w64) : Persistent (isVote γ v term cand)

theorem logRecs_boot_intro [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (L : List EntryM) : γ.reBoot = L → PlogWf
    base0 L → ↑L.length < 2 ^ 64 → (∀ (e : EntryM), e ∈ L → e.Term' = W64 1) → ([∗list] e ∈ L,
    entData γ e) ⊢ logRecs γ base0 L

def commitIn [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F : List EntryM) (c tm : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(commitJ γ F c tm ∗ dynOn γ (witsB γ F (uint.Z c).toNat (uint.Z tm + 1)))

def isEntryR [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (e : EntryM) (pt : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((∃ ldr γt b l0 F0,
        isLeader γ ldr e.Term' ∗
          isTermLog γ ldr e.Term' γt b l0 ∗
            isCamp γ ldr e.Term' F0 ∗
              e.Index' ↪[γt]□ (e, pt) ∗
                ⌜PtOk F0 e.Term' (uint.Z e.Index') pt⌝ ∗ entData γ e ∗ ⧖((uint.Z e.Index').toNat - γ.reBoot.length)) ∨
      ⌜BootRec γ.reBoot e pt⌝ ∗ entData γ e)

theorem ownCommitted_timeless (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) : Timeless (ownCommitted γ l)

def entData (γ : RaftNames) (e : EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ o, entDataIs γ e o)

theorem cqAt_intro [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (t n : w64) (G : List EntryM) (a : w64) (c : CfgM)
    (q : GSet w64) (M : DecMap) : plogTermAt base0 G n = some t → uint.Z a ≤ uint.Z n → CfgAt γ M
    (List.take (uint.Z a).toNat G) c → JQuorum c q → ⊢ decLb γ M -∗ leadFull γ t G -∗ isCommitted γ
    (List.take (uint.Z a).toNat G) -∗ ([∗map] v ↦ _u ∈ toMap q, iprop(∃ i', ⌜uint.Z n ≤ uint.Z i'⌝ ∗
    isAcked γ v t i')) -∗ dynOn γ (cqDyn γ t G a) -∗ cqAt γ t n G a c q

theorem CfgAt.static {γ : RaftNames} {M : DecMap} {P : List EntryM} {c : CfgM} (Hst : γ.reDyn =
    none) (H : CfgAt γ M P c) : CfgStatic γ c

def DynCfg.all [ext : GooseExts] (D : DynCfg) (e : GooseExts) : DynCfg :=
  if h : e = ext then ⋯ ▸ D else DynCfg.trivial

theorem leadPrefix_wf [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (L t : w64) (b : entryID) (l : List EntryM) : ⊢
    leadPrefix γ L t b l -∗ ⌜PlogWfR b l⌝ ∗ logRecs γ b l

theorem isVote_timeless (γ : RaftNames) (v term cand : w64) : Timeless (isVote γ v term cand)

theorem cqAt_timeless_aux [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (N : Nat) (t n : w64) (G : List EntryM) (a
    : w64) (c : CfgM) (q : GSet w64) : (uint.Z a).toNat < N → Timeless (cqAt γ t n G a c q)

theorem msgsTks_singleton [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) : msgsTks γ [m] ⊣⊢ msgTks γ m

theorem propsOf_cons (m : Msg) (l : List Msg) : propsOf (m :: l) = if m.ty = MsgType.propose then m
    :: propsOf l else propsOf l

theorem entDataIs_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (e : EntryM) (o : Option (List w8)) : Persistent
    (entDataIs γ e o)

theorem cqAt_unfold [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (t n : w64) (G : List EntryM) (a : w64) (c :
    CfgM) (q : GSet w64) : cqAt γ t n G a c q = iprop(⌜plogTermAt base0 G n = some t⌝ ∗ leadFull γ t
    G ∗ (∃ M, ⌜uint.Z a ≤ uint.Z n ∧ CfgAt γ M (List.take (uint.Z a).toNat G) c ∧ JQuorum c q⌝ ∗
    decLb γ M) ∗ isCommitted γ (List.take (uint.Z a).toNat G) ∗ ([∗map] v ↦ _u ∈ toMap q, iprop(∃
    i', ⌜uint.Z n ≤ uint.Z i'⌝ ∗ isAcked γ v t i')) ∗ dynOn γ (cqDyn γ t G a))

theorem full_take_eq [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F1 F2 : List EntryM) (c : w64) : PlogWf base0
    F1 → PlogWf base0 F2 → (plogTermAt base0 F1 c).isSome = true → plogTermAt base0 F1 c =
    plogTermAt base0 F2 c → ⊢ logRecs γ base0 F1 -∗ logRecs γ base0 F2 -∗ ⌜List.take (uint.Z
    c).toNat F1 = List.take (uint.Z c).toNat F2⌝

theorem isEntryR_boot [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (e : EntryM) (pt : w64) : ⊢ isEntryR γ e pt -∗
    ⌜BootRec γ.reBoot e pt ∨ ↑γ.reBoot.length < uint.Z e.Index'⌝

def DynCfg.trivial : DynCfg :=
  { fold := fun x x_1 => none, mono := ⋯, adj := ⋯ }

theorem okL_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (t : w64) (B : Int) (j : w64) (X : List EntryM)
    : Timeless (okL γ t B j X)

theorem commitIn_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F : List EntryM) (c tm : w64) : Timeless
    (commitIn γ F c tm)

theorem hist_keep [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F F' : List EntryM) (t i : w64) (B : Int) : (∀ (j
    : w64), 0 < uint.Z j ∧ uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z i → (plogTermAt base0 F j).isSome = true → plogTermAt
    base0 F' j = plogTermAt base0 F j) → ⊢ hist γ F t i B -∗ hist γ F' t i B

def snapRegOk (γ : RaftNames) (i : w64) (d : List w8) : IProp GF :=
  match γ.reSnapReg with
  | none => iprop(True)
  | some g => iprop(∃ K, monoListLbOwn g K ∗ ⌜(i, d) ∈ K⌝)

theorem isCommitted_agree [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l1 l2 : List EntryM) : ⊢ isCommitted γ l1
    -∗ isCommitted γ l2 -∗ ⌜l1 <+: l2 ∨ l2 <+: l1⌝

theorem lpfull_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (ldr t : w64) (bL : entryID) (l fp : List
    EntryM) : Persistent (lpfull γ ldr t bL l fp)

def TrackedOk (γ : RaftNames) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) : Prop :=
  ∀ (T : GSet w64), γ.reTracked = some T → c.voters ∪ c.learners ⊆ T ∧ id ∈ T

def isCommitted (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  isCommittedDef γ l

theorem isWin_tbl_agree [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id1 id2 term : w64) (q1 q2 : GSet w64) : ⊢
    isWin γ id1 term q1 -∗ isWin γ id2 term q2 -∗ ⌜id1 = id2 ∧ q1 = q2⌝

def isWinCore (γ : RaftNames) (id term : w64) (c : CfgM) (q : GSet w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γw F0 k M,
      ⌜γ.reWins !! id = some γw ∧ JQuorum c q ∧ CfgAt γ M (List.take (uint.Z k).toNat F0) c⌝ ∗
        isCampK γ id term F0 k ∗ term ↪[γw]□ q ∗ ([∗map] v ↦ _u ∈ toMap q, isVote γ v term id) ∗ decLb γ M)

theorem isCommitted_unseal : @isCommitted = @isCommittedDef

def isTermLog (γ : RaftNames) (v t : w64) (γt : GName) (b : entryID) (l0 : List EntryM) : IProp GF
    :=
  iprop(∃ γm, ⌜γ.reTerms !! v = some γm⌝ ∗ t ↪[γm]□ ((γt, b), l0))

def CfgAt (γ : RaftNames) (M : DecMap) (P : List EntryM) (c : CfgM) : Prop :=
  match γ.dyn with
  | none => CfgStatic γ c
  | some D => D.fold M P = some c

theorem CfgStatic.simple (γ : RaftNames) (lrn : GSet w64) (Hst : γ.reDyn = none) : CfgStatic γ
    (CfgM.simple γ.reCfg lrn)

theorem leadFull_boot [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (t : w64) (G : List EntryM) : ⊢ leadFull γ t G
    -∗ ⌜γ.reBoot <+: G ∧ (γ.reBoot ≠ [] → 2 ≤ uint.Z t)⌝

def okL [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (t : w64) (B : Int) (j : w64) (X : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((∃ t'', ⌜uint.Z t ≤ uint.Z t'' ∧ uint.Z t'' < B⌝ ∗ leadFull γ t'' X) ∨
      (∃ t'' n'', ⌜uint.Z t'' < uint.Z t ∧ uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z n''⌝ ∗ cq γ t'' n'' X) ∨
        ⌜uint.Z j ≤ ↑γ.reBoot.length ∧ X = γ.reBoot⌝)

def cqAt [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (t n : w64) (G : List EntryM) (a : w64) (c : CfgM) (q : GSet
    w64) : IProp GF :=
  cqAt._unary γ ⟨t, ⟨n, ⟨G, ⟨a, ⟨c, q⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩

theorem leadFrags_persistent (γt : GName) (l0 l : List EntryM) : Persistent (leadFrags γt l0 l)

def baseOk [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (b : entryID) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜uint.Z b.index' = 0⌝ ∨ isSnapMeta γ b.term' b.index')

theorem witsB_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F : List EntryM) (lim : Nat) (B : Int) :
    Timeless (witsB γ F lim B)

def raftpbEntry_countable : Pos.Countable EntryM :=

  ∀ (p1 p2 : Nat) (e1 e2 : Aev), p1 < p2 → L[p1]? = some e1 → L[p2]? = some e2 → uint.Z (aevTerm e1) ≤ uint.Z (aevTerm e2)

    tm ≤ uint.Z tm' → plogTermAt base0 F' c = plogTermAt base0 F c → List.take (uint.Z c).toNat F' =
    List.take (uint.Z c).toNat F → ⊢ commitIn γ F c tm -∗ commitIn γ F' c tm'

def WitOk (F : List EntryM) (k : Nat) (t' n' : w64) (G' : List EntryM) (a' : w64) (B : Int) : Prop
    :=
  uint.Z t' < B ∧
    ↑k + 1 ≤ uint.Z n' ∧
      (uint.Z a').toNat ≤ k ∧
        List.take (k + 1) G' = List.take (k + 1) F ∧
          confCount (List.take (uint.Z a').toNat G') = confCount (List.take k F)

  iprop(∃ a c q, cqAt γ t n G a c q)

    : DecCompat M1 M2) (Hp : P1 <+: P2 ∨ P2 <+: P1) (Hc1 : confCount P2 ≤ confCount P1 + 1) (Hc2 :
    confCount P1 ≤ confCount P2 + 1) (H1 : CfgAt γ M1 P1 c1) (H2 : CfgAt γ M2 P2 c2) : QOverlap c1
    c2

  Pos.Countable.ofInjective
    (fun x =>
      match x with
      | ConfChangeIM.v1 m => Pos.Countable.encode (Sum.inl (m.type, m.nodeId, m.context, m.id))
      | ConfChangeIM.v2 m => Pos.Countable.encode (Sum.inr (m.transition, m.changes, m.context)))
    ⋯

    EntryM) : Persistent (okL γ t B j X)

def SnapListsOk (k : SnapTrip) : Prop :=
  CSWf k.cl.outgoing k.cl.voters k.cl.learners k.cl.learnersNext ∧
    k.cl.voters.Nodup ∧
      k.cl.learners.Nodup ∧
        k.cl.outgoing.Nodup ∧
          k.cl.learnersNext.Nodup ∧
            ↑k.cl.voters.length + ↑k.cl.learners.length + ↑k.cl.outgoing.length + ↑k.cl.learnersNext.length ≤ 2 ^ 62 ∧
              (k.cl.outgoing = [] → k.al = false) ∧ uint.Z k.sid.index' < 2 ^ 61

def commitJ [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F : List EntryM) (c tm : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜uint.Z c ≤ ↑γ.reBoot.length ∧ plogTermAt base0 γ.reBoot c = plogTermAt base0 F c⌝ ∨
      ∃ t n G, cq γ t n G ∗ ⌜uint.Z c ≤ uint.Z n ∧ uint.Z t ≤ uint.Z tm ∧ plogTermAt base0 G c = plogTermAt base0 F c⌝)

theorem logRecs_lookup [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F : List EntryM) (k : Nat) (e : EntryM) :
    F[k]? = some e → ↑k + 1 < 2 ^ 64 → ⊢ logRecs γ base0 F -∗ ∃ pt, ⌜plogTermAt base0 F (W64 ↑k) =
    some pt⌝ ∗ isEntryR γ e pt

theorem full_match [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F1 F2 : List EntryM) (i : w64) : PlogWf base0 F1
    → PlogWf base0 F2 → (plogTermAt base0 F1 i).isSome = true → plogTermAt base0 F1 i = plogTermAt
    base0 F2 i → ⊢ logRecs γ base0 F1 -∗ logRecs γ base0 F2 -∗ ⌜∀ (j : w64), uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z i →
    plogTermAt base0 F1 j = plogTermAt base0 F2 j⌝

  iprop(⌜uint.Z i ≤ ↑γ.reBoot.length⌝ ∨ ∃ t n G, ⌜uint.Z i ≤ uint.Z n⌝ ∗ cq γ t n G)

    L.length) : List.take c L' = List.take c L

def snapAtOk (γ : RaftNames) (k : SnapTrip) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜γ.reSnapReg = none⌝ ∨
      ∃ L M,
        isCommitted γ L ∗
          decLb γ M ∗
            ⌜L.length = uint.nat k.sid.index' ∧
                Option.map EntryM.Term' L.getLast? = some k.sid.term' ∧
                  SnapListsOk k ∧ ∀ (D : DynCfg), γ.dyn = some D → D.fold M L = some k.cfgM⌝)

def leadPrefix [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (ldr t : w64) (bL : entryID) (l : List EntryM) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(isLeader γ ldr t ∗
      ∃ γt l0, isTermLog γ ldr t γt bL l0 ∗ ⌜PlogWfR bL l ∧ l0 <+: l⌝ ∗ logRecs γ bL l ∗ leadFrags γt l0 l)

def lpfull [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (ldr t : w64) (bL : entryID) (l fp : List EntryM) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(∃ F0,
      isCamp γ ldr t F0 ∗
        logRecs γ base0 fp ∗
          ⌜FullOk bL fp ∧
              F0 <+: fp ++ l ∧ PlogWf bL l ∧ ∀ (j x : w64), plogTermAt base0 (fp ++ l) j = some x → uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z t⌝)

    PlogWf base0 F → (plogTermAt base0 X i).isSome = true → plogTermAt base0 X i = plogTermAt base0
    F i → ⊢ logRecs γ base0 F -∗ okL γ t B i X -∗ hist γ F t i B

    EntryM) : ⊢ leadPrefix γ ldr t bL l -∗ lpfull γ ldr t bL l fp -∗ leadFull γ t (fp ++ l)

    → ⊢ hist γ F t i B -∗ hist γ F t i B'

    e.Index').toNat - γ.reBoot.length)

    base0 F -∗ ⌜∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), F[k]? = some e → k < γ.reBoot.length → γ.reBoot[k]? = some
    e ∧ e.Term' = W64 1⌝

    w64) : e1.Term' = e2.Term' → e1.Index' = e2.Index' → ⊢ isEntryR γ e1 pt1 -∗ isEntryR γ e2 pt2 -∗
    ⌜e1 = e2 ∧ pt1 = pt2⌝

def isWin (γ : RaftNames) (id term : w64) (q : GSet w64) : IProp GF :=

    base0 F -∗ ⌜∀ (j k x y : w64), uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z k → plogTermAt base0 F j = some x → plogTermAt
    base0 F k = some y → uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z y⌝

def isCampK (γ : RaftNames) (c T : w64) (F : List EntryM) (k : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γc,
      ⌜γ.reCamp !! c = some γc ∧
            CampOk T F ∧ uint.Z k ≤ plogLastIndexZ base0 F ∧ γ.reBoot <+: F ∧ (γ.reBoot ≠ [] → 2 ≤ uint.Z T)⌝ ∗
        T ↪[γc]□ (F, k) ∗ isCommitted γ (List.take (uint.Z k).toNat F))

def propDataIs (γ : RaftNames) (e : EntryM) : Option (List w8) → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => iprop(⌜Filler e.Type' e.Data' ∧ CCDecodes e.Type' e.Data'⌝)
  | some k => iprop(⌜entKey e.Type' e.Data' = k ∧ ¬Filler e.Type' e.Data' ∧ CCDecodes e.Type' e.Data'⌝ ∗ deposited γ k)

def hist [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F : List EntryM) (t i : w64) (B : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ j x,
      (∃ X, okL γ t B j X ∗ ⌜(plogTermAt base0 X j).isSome = true ∧ plogTermAt base0 X j = plogTermAt base0 F j⌝) ∨
        ∃ j' X1 X2,
          ⌜uint.Z j' ≤ uint.Z j⌝ ∗
            okL γ t B j' X1 ∗
              okL γ t B j' X2 ∗
                ⌜(plogTermAt base0 X1 j').isSome = true ∧
                    (plogTermAt base0 X2 j').isSome = true ∧ plogTermAt base0 X1 j' ≠ plogTermAt base0 X2 j'⌝)

    CfgM) (q : GSet w64) : cqAt γ t n G a c q = iprop(⌜plogTermAt base0 G n = some t⌝ ∗ leadFull γ t
    G ∗ (∃ M, ⌜uint.Z a ≤ uint.Z n ∧ CfgAt γ M (List.take (uint.Z a).toNat G) c ∧ JQuorum c q⌝ ∗
    decLb γ M) ∗ isCommitted γ (List.take (uint.Z a).toNat G) ∗ ([∗map] v ↦ _u ∈ toMap q, iprop(∃
    i', ⌜uint.Z n ≤ uint.Z i'⌝ ∗ isAcked γ v t i')) ∗ (⌜γ.reDyn = none⌝ ∨ ⌜ConfI1 G (uint.Z
    a).toNat⌝ ∗ ∀ k x x, ∃ t' n' G' a' c' q' x, cqAt γ t' n' G' a' c' q'))

def Aev_countable : Pos.Countable Aev :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective
    (fun x =>
      match x with
      | Aev.ack t i => Pos.Countable.encode (Sum.inl (t, i))
      | Aev.vote T d F => Pos.Countable.encode (Sum.inr (T, d, F)))
    ⋯
